steps.clue: Activate the three AMP Generators to restore power and raise Pack-a-Punch.
Open the Research Office with Dead Wire, activate the laptops and solve the Resonator equations.
Charge the Multiphasic Resonator at the island orbs and build the DRI-11 Beamsmasher.
Use the Beamsmasher to recover the Hard Drive, then release and defeat Nathan.
Recover the Project Janus Keycard and survive the shipwreck lockdown to obtain the Node Connectors.
Repair the network lines and retrieve the Hacking Device from Peck.
Hack the three satellite buoys within two minutes.
Defuse the three bombs in the Bio Lab within five minutes.
Enter the boss arena and defeat Patient 13.
